[RDSC.4a.6.2] **A REGEX test whose subject is not a `String` faults.** A regex match takes a `String` ([LREG.1.1]), so the
compiler emits an `ALPHA_TEST_REGEX` test only on a `String` slot ([RLOW.5.2.2]). An
artefact whose REGEX test reads a slot value that is not a `String` lies about
that slot. Where the engine evaluates such a test, it **must** raise an
`EngineError` of `ENGINE_FAULT_ARTEFACT_LIED`
(`proto/engine_fault.proto#EngineFault`) naming `$alpha_<id>` ([LERR.9.11]), and
halt the tier ([LERR.1.4.7]). It **must not** answer the test `false` instead.

The test is one conjunct of its node's tests, as a slot index that names nothing
is ([RDSC.4a.9.1]). A test of the node that answers `false` decides the fact
wherever it stands, and the engine raises the fault only when none does
([LNUL.4.2]).
